description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Wind] and [Spellblade Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Wind
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Spellblade Whirlwind after casting an equipped Spellblade ability

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking], [Dual Wind Spellblade Mode], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Wind], removes [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Wind]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Dual Wind Spellblade Mode
description.text: Grants [Spellblade +10% Boost 1]/[Spellblade +30% Boost 1]/[Spellblade +50% Boost 1] to the user after using a Spellblade ability if the user has [Wind Infusion 0~1/2/3], casts Dual Gale Slash after using Spellblade abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Wind]

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Wind
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Dual Gale Slash
description.text: One single attack (2.51/2.64/3.04/3.44) capped at 99999 if the user has Attach Wind 0/1/2/3, 100% hit rate, causes [Detach Wind] to the user

description.name: Dual Spellblade Whirlwind
description.text: 5/15 single attacks (0.30 each) every 1+2n/2+2n uses, 100% additional critical chance, 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
